sloka: विद्रुतां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा स ददर्श नरान्तकम्।गृहीतप्रासमायान्तं हयपृष्ठे प्रतिष्ठितम् ।। ६.६९.८३ ।।
transliteration: vidrutāṁ vāhinīṁ dṛṣṭvā sa dadarśa narāntakam।gṛhītaprāsamāyāntaṁ hayapṛṣṭhe pratiṣṭhitam ।। 6.69.83 ।।

translations.english: On hearing the king's words, Angada went just as the sun rays comes out of a cluster of clouds.
